Elena —

Appreciate the questionnaire. Attached are two artifacts that should be helpful: a simplified data flow diagram and a one-page retention summary. I’ve answered the highlighted items inline in the attached spreadsheet as well (see column "RI responses"). Key points below for quick reference.

Region pinning
- Hosted API: customers may elect region pinning (US, EU, APAC) at signup; we will guarantee primary tenant data and persistent storage are kept in the chosen region. For SigmaHealth we can pin to US-only. Note: model execution may call transient compute in multiple AZs within the region for scaling.

Retention windows (default / configurable)
- Request metadata & audit logs: default 90 days; configurable down to 30 days for enterprise plans. Logs used for debugging are retained by default for 90d and can be reduced with written request.
- User-provided content (prompt inputs, files uploaded): default 30 days ephemeral TTL for hosted API (customer-controlled TTL available for Dedicated/Private).
- Model-generated outputs (responses): default aligned with inputs (30 days) unless customer requests otherwise.
- KV/prefix caches: ephemeral by design; entries expire based on session TTL (default 24 hours) unless customer configures longer-lived cache, which we do not persist beyond tenant lifecycle.

Deletion and verification process
- Tenant termination flow: 1) soft-delete flags all tenant persistent objects (immediate) 2) background purge job removes data according to retention SLA (irreversible purge within 30 days of termination by default) 3) final storage-level wipe/overwrite for object storage copies within 60 days depending on underlying cloud provider snapshot windows.
- Evidence: upon completion we provide a signed erasure confirmation PDF and a storage-level purge report (object IDs + timestamps). We can also provide a log extract showing deletion events scoped to tenant IDs.

Access controls & keys
- Customer data encryption: all persisted data encrypted at rest using provider-managed keys by default. We offer customer-managed KMS integration (bring-your-own-key) for Private and Enterprise Dedicated plans.
- Audit logs: access to production systems is logged; privileged access is controlled via RBAC and SSO; we can provide a redacted access log extract for compliance reviews on request.

Compliance evidence
- We maintain SOC 2 Type II and can provide the relevant report under NDA. Our InfoSec team can deliver additional artifacts (architecture diagram, retention policy excerpts).

Short note: I answered the spreadsheet inline. If you want tightened retention windows (e.g., 30-day log retention + immediate purge), we may need a contract addendum since it affects operational SLOs.

Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive

- Region pinning: Confirmed for US-only. We will mark SigmaHealth tenant as US-pin at provisioning and route persistent storage to US-region buckets.
- Logs & meta: Default 90d retention; enterprise configurable to 30d via contractual SLA.
- Customer content (prompts & outputs): Default 30d ephemeral TTL for Hosted API; configurable policies available on Dedicated/Private.
- Deletion flow: soft-delete immediate; irreversible purge initiated within 30 days; storage-level overwrite/snapshot expiration complete within 60 days in typical cloud provider windows. We will provide a purge report (object ids + timestamps) and a signed erasure confirmation PDF after completion.
- Caches & ephemeral data: KV and prefix caches are session-scoped and expire per configured TTL (default 24h); not persisted beyond tenant lifecycle.
